CustomField.description: Google Gemini API key for the GUS chat proxy, used when Chat_Provider__c is Gemini. Plain Text: GTM_Agent_Settings__c is a Hierarchy Custom Setting, which does not support EncryptedText; protection is the Apex-level write-only/never-prefill boundary in GtmAgentSettingsController, matching Claude_API_Key__c and OpenAI_API_Key__c.
CustomField.label: Gemini API Key
